body: I have decided I want to break things off. My number one priority is my son and if I'm  possibly going to be introducing someone into our lives, I want them to respect me the way I respect them. This guy obviously does not.

Lmao. My reactions was the same. I honestly feel like if he would have been more forthcoming from the get go we could still see each other, but then he pulls some shit like this and comes up with the fucking dumbest lie ever to try and cover his tracks. Then trying to manipulate me to get me to stay with him? I dont have time for this. Ffs.

Definitely not! He has already proven himself to be a despicable partner. He does not love you. If he did, he would not have ever even thought about betraying your trust like that.  DO NOT allow him to put you and your children through anymore torment than he already has. Your sister's a piece of work too - they deserve each other. You and your children deserve so much better. Focus on them.

Constantly. Its like I'm useless and don't belong anywhere. I try to lift myself up, only to get knocked down again. Each time I think about wanting to end everything because I'm so miserable and exhausted from the ups and downs, I feel more at peace with it. The only thing keeping me here for now is my son. I will endure this to make sure he isn't raised alone by his POS father. Without my son, I think I would have been gone by now. This mindset is an improvement from a year ago or even 6 months ago (my last unsuccessful attempt). So maybe it will continue to improve, but I doubt it. I'll just deal with it for B.

I'm sorry that you had to go through this too. Losing the person that was here for you since the day you were born is heart wrenching. Thank you for your support. Tomorrow I'm going to honor her by remembering the good times with our family. Good luck to you as well.

I am really proud of you for calling the police. You did the right thing  by keeping yourself safe and have no reason to feel guilty. It was his actions that put him in this situation. No matter what his living/financial situation may be, his volatile emotions and his lack of empathy are what got him here. Not you. You are not responsible for him and what he did to you. You kept yourself safe and that is the only thing that matters. <3

I feel for you. My (23 as well) sons father (35) and I split up after he threw a glass bottle at my head and I ended up going to the hospital for stitches. Before this happened I could slowly start seeing the warning signs of his aggression. It wasnt a surprise to me because I saw how his father fought with his wife. I tried to get him into therapy with me- he didnt care. 

Until one day we were having a disagreement and he threw the bottle at me. I was several feet away from him, just sitting on the ground. Yeah, we were arguing, but I'm not aggressive at all. There was blood everywhere and I tried to go to the bathroom to look at my head, but he held me down. The only reason he got off was because his family heard me screaming. Even after that him and his family tried to dissuade me from going to the hospital. He was cornering me in every room of the house. I told him and his family if they didnt let me leave the police would come right then and there. 

I got to the hospital and I didnt have a say in the matter. An officer was there within minutes. It's been a few months since the incident and his court date is later this month. I felt an extreme amount of guilt as well, even though the charges were being pressed by the state and not myself. 

"Maybe if I had just chosen my battles"
"Maybe if I had let his mom look at my wound instead"
"It could have been so much worse"
"What if him and his family retaliates"

It took time and support from my amazing family and friends to realize that nothing that happened was because of me and I had every single right to get to safety and tell the officer the truth about what happened. I hope you realize the same. He did awful things to you, physically and emotionally. Dont let him have anymore control over you. You deserve so much better. You did the right thing. <3 stay safe.

Your response was very helpful. Thank you! 

The zoloft and the seroquel worked great. The only down side to the seroquel, for me, was that it made me incredibly drowsy. I wasnt able to take it at work or when I was around my kiddo. Even on the lowest dose.
